children: China's exports are likely to stay strong, Citi analysts say in a research note. China's exports and imports surged in August, the bank says. "August's trade data point to a strong export engine, supported by the AI capex cycle, Asian supply chain demand, and higher export prices," the bank says. Investors are closely watching the coming Trump-Xi summit 2.0, which provides near-term trade policy stability, they add. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
